historicalHub.name: Phoenician Heritage Gateway
historicalHub.description: Historical central transit courtyard connecting players to the 5 major Phoenician and Punic architectural environments without modifying the modern world registry.

sites.name: Ancient Byblos (Gebal / Gubla)
sites.summary: Foremost Canaanite/Phoenician maritime port, continuous habitation from 5000 BCE, exporter of cedarwood, papyrus trade, origin of the linear alphabet.

sites.name: Ancient Tyre (Ṣūr)
sites.summary: Fortified Phoenician offshore island citadel, twin harbors (Sidonian & Egyptian), imperial Tyrian purple dye center, and Alexander's 332 BCE mole.

sites.name: Ancient Sidon (Ṣaydūn)
sites.summary: Celebrated coastal artisan metropolis renowned for core-formed glass ateliers, purple dye industry, and the monumental healing sanctuary of Eshmun at Bostan esh-Sheikh.

sites.name: Punic Carthage (Qart-ḥadašt)
sites.summary: Magnificent Western Mediterranean Phoenician metropolis: Byrsa citadel, Magon residential district with Opus Africanum architecture, and twin naval/commercial Cothon harbor.

sites.name: Ancient Motya (Mozia)
sites.summary: Protected lagoon island stronghold in western Sicily, featuring an engineered submerged causeway to Birgi, fortified bastions, artificial Kothon basin, and the 397 BCE siege.
